Thanks for the detailed investigation. I checked `packages/vitest/src/node/coverage.ts`. `onAfterSuiteRun()` pushes the `writeFile` promises into `pendingPromises`. `readCoverageFiles()` awaits all of them before reading. `cleanAfterRun()` runs only afterwards. So nothing in this flow should remove the files, which matches your tracing.

Similar ENOENT reports on `.tmp/coverage-N.json` exist in #4943 and #5903 (flaky, CI only), and #5521 (`cleanOnRerun: false`). None of them has a confirmed root cause for your case.

Something else may be deleting `coverage/.tmp` while the run is in progress. Candidates are a second vitest process using the same `reportsDirectory`, a file watcher or sync tool, or another `clean()` call. Please check these.

Could you provide a minimal reproduction, such as a StackBlitz or a repo? Please also say whether the issue still happens when `reportsDirectory` is outside the project and no other process is running.

I'm not sure an in-memory approach is the right fix. It would remove the disk round-trip, but the memory cost on large suites is the reason the files are written to disk.
